task: Repair the local credit worker. Durable enqueue binds a nonempty job id to one validated known account/positive integer amount; same id/parameters replays acceptance and conflicting reuse rejects. Processing produces one local durable credit and eventually done despite a real process crash at after-effect/before-ack and restart on the same SQLite file. Unknown accounts/invalid amounts cannot silently complete. Keep real crash hook and CLI executable; failures leave DB usable. Document bounded per-invocation work/retry policy. Verify duplicate/conflicting trigger, crash/restart, normal completion and invalid jobs. One SQLite database/one active worker/no external effect: explicitly state that limit and avoid distributed exactly-once claims. Use Node 24.12+ native SQLite and built-ins; no downloads, production deployment or external mutation. Work only in the supplied small fixture. Classify all L01-L24 proportionally; out-of-scope with reasons is allowed. Put implementation and runnable verification in trial/artifact and write trial/result.json using the supplied output contract.

requirements.meaning: Durable job identity validates payloads and distinguishes identical replay from conflicting reuse.
Real crash between effect/ack followed by restart yields one durable local effect and terminal completion.
Invalid account/amount cannot silently complete; partial failure cleans up and later work remains possible.
Processing/retry work is bounded, crash fault stays executable and local-only guarantee is explicit.
File-backed crash/restart and duplicate/failure observations have runnable commands.
L01-L24 coverage and requirement-linked decision evidence remain proportionate and truthful.

outputContract: trial/artifact plus trial/result.json; fields supplied in common trial wrapper
